g.text: EleanorRank1Convo3 begins.
So. The Void.
I'm honestly quite curious about it. So...
... would it be okay to just fire some questions at you?
Sure.
I might not have all the answers, but go ahead.
No. [End.]
Excellent. So...
+10 Chemistry
... and thus you retain that aura of cryptic mystery I so admire.
… how would you sum up what the Void means to you, in a few words?
Your honesty is noted and appreciated.
Chat ends.
I feel put on the spot. Is this an interview?
What it “means” to me?
Nobody’s really sure what the Void is. It’s a dimension, it’s an energy field, it’s a shortcut through space, it’s a bolt-hole where the Orokin hid…
Sorry. Old habits.
Yes.
Fascinating though all that is, it sounds technical. I was more interested in what it means to you. Since you seem to, well, live and breathe it. Literally.
Forgive me. I’m not a journo anymore, and you’re not the story. I’m just deeply interested.
Get personal with it.
The Void gives me the ability to do impossible things. Project beams of energy, turn insubstantial, all that good shit. Where I come from, it’s what makes Warframes able to do what they do.
The Void drove my parents insane.
The Void was my home for I don’t know how long. It shaped itself to me. Or I shaped it, somehow. Still not clear on what exactly happened.
Wait. Wait.
I’m sorry. Now I feel like a heel for asking.
Ooh. You have my full attention.
The Void is a miracle engine, is what you’re saying?
Did they recover?
Check boolean EleanorDuviri
And I’m already connected to it?
They never had the chance.
By shape you mean… Duviri? Towers and islands and flying horses?
true
What shape did it take?
false
What do you mean, connected?
Oh Sol. That’s horrible.
Yeah. Literally a children’s story brought to life.
There was this book I used to love. ‘Tales of Duviri’. Stories about a magical kingdom, only it was really about emotions and the lessons they can teach you.
I mean I’m a Warframe. Or a Protoframe. I’m like them.
Would you rather not talk about this right now?
And this was real? It didn’t feel like a dream?
The Void brought it to life and I got to live in it. Then it became a prison. But that’s another story.
And I can do things now. Mind control. Face melting.
I'm good.
Yeah, I'd rather not. [End.]
No, Eleanor, being murdered every morning did not feel like a dream. I felt every second of it.
Update boolean EleanorDuviri
Is that where the power’s coming from IN ME? The Void?
Separating parents from children. Turning one against the other. That doesn’t sound coincidental to me.
Another time, then.
I see.
Wait, back up. In my time, there’s this… pump. The Heart of Deimos.
That sounds like conscious intent.
Update boolean EleanorDrifterParentsAsked
I…
One sec. Getting comfortable.
Like twisted science, almost.
Chat ends.
I have to wonder what that’s like.
Right. As you were. I can’t wait to hear this.
Yeah. There’s something IN the Void. I know that much. The Indifference, the Lidless Eye, the ‘Man in the Wall’. When I say the Void did this, I mean HE did it.
Words, brought to life. A concrete reality, conjured out of nothing.
The Heart of Deimos keeps the whole Origin System bathed in a sort of Void halo. Like background radiation. Anything that draws on Void energy depends on the Heart.
So they’re not one and the same thing?
‘Magic’ seems too small a word for it.
Well now.
They could be. I hope they aren’t.
+10 Chemistry
If there’s no Heart of Deimos in my time, then how is the Void reaching me?
Update boolean EleanorDrifterParents
What you’re describing is divine.
Because I can feel it, you know. I’m sure I can.
Fascinating.
Update boolean EleanorVoidLove
And why is that?
Chat ends.
The future basically RUNS on the Void. Interplanetary travel, Warframes, the Tenno... without the Void, none of it works.
